messages:
Alex: who wants to bet a burrito on tonight's PKs? Loser buys 3 burritos. 8pm kickoff. Team Red looks shaky from spot kicks. :taco: @Maria @Sam
Maria: I'm in but only if it's breakfast burritos. :raised_hands:
Jong: count me in, but I'm taking Team Blue. Also, can we order from El Camino? Their burritos > all.
Sam: ugh my fantasy playoffs overlap. If I win i'll take credit, if I lose someone remind me to Venmo. :grimacing:
Taylor: poll: Team Red / Team Blue / No PKs — vote with emoji
Alex: quick heads up — ops-bot, is kitchen doing burrito run tonight? Need to know order cutoff.
ops-bot: Kitchen status: burrito run allowed. Please label orders with 'PK-BET' in this thread for tally. Orders cutoff 7:30pm.
Maria: PK-BET: Maria — 3x breakfast (El Camino). +1 for chips. :yum:
Sam: PK-BET: Sam — 2x carne asada. Also can someone stream at my desk? I have a 15-min deploy window at 7:45.
Jong: I'll mirror the stream in conf-room B. Bring headphones if you want sound.
Taylor: reminder for fantasy folks: lock lineups by 7:50pm or you'll auto-sub. :alarm_clock:
Alex: ok final stakes: winner picks the burrito place and losers split cost. Writing down picks: Alex=Team Red, Maria=Team Red, Jong=Team Blue, Sam=Team Blue, Taylor=leaning Team Red.
Maria: +:thumbsup: good luck y'all. Loser pics will be painful.
ops-bot: A friendly reminder: label your order with 'PK-BET' and include dietary notes. Cutoff in 12 minutes.
Sam: noted. placing order now. Venmo details in DM if i lose.
Taylor: bets locked for me. may the better penalty-taker win. :soccer:
Alex: stream plan set. See you at 8pm (or at least the burrito aftermath).
